subject: Rack & stack and cabling field support for your Twinsburg, OH hardware deployment
body:
Hello,

We can support rack & stack, structured cabling, and adherence to customer documentation and site procedures for your deployment.

Key capabilities:

  • Device mounting and rack & stack
  • Cabling between devices with tested labeling
  • Customer documentation and site-procedure compliance
  • Credential and access-compliance readiness coordination

This work can be executed with field-ready technicians and a clear sign-off checklist.

Learn more about our services: https://ziontechgroup.com

Schedule a quick call: https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup

Best,
Kleber Garcia Alcatrao
CEO — Zion Tech Group
